If they choose war, the only actions they may play or activate during their next turn are weapon and attack actions.
If they choose peace, the only actions they may play or activate during their next turn are non-weapon non-attack actions.

withering_shot.text_zh:
若枯萎箭带有一个瞄准指示物，它获得+1力量。
当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个虚弱衍生物。
withering_shot.text_en:
If Withering Shot has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, create a Frailty token under their control.

withstand.text_zh: 本回合目标守护者副手下一次防御时，它获得+6防御直到战斗链关闭。
withstand.text_en: The next time target Guardian off-hand defends this turn, it gains +6{d} until the combat chain closes.

wounded_bull.text_zh: 当你使用此牌时，若你的生命低于一位对手英雄，此牌获得+1力量。
wounded_bull.text_en: When you play this, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, this gains +1{p}.

wrath_of_retribution.text_zh:
传奇
每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
当此牌攻击时，你控制的匕首获得+1力量且本战斗链中启动费用减少1点资源。
再动
wrath_of_retribution.text_en:
Legendary
This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.
When this attacks, daggers you control get +1{p} and cost {r} less to activate this combat chain.
Go again

wreck_havoc.text_zh:
此链环不能使用防御反应牌。
当此牌命中英雄时，你可以将其军械库中的一张牌翻为正面朝上，然后摧毁其军械库中的一张防御反应牌。
wreck_havoc.text_en:
Defense reactions can't be played to this chain link.
When this hits a hero, you may turn a card in their arsenal face up, then destroy a defense reaction in their arsenal.

wrecker_romp.text_zh: 作为使用此牌的额外费用，随机弃一张牌。
wrecker_romp.text_en: As an additional cost to play this, discard a random card.

wrecking_ball.text_zh: 当你用破坏球攻击时，抽一张牌，然后随机弃一张牌。若以此方式弃置的是力量为6或更高的牌，威吓。
wrecking_ball.text_en: When you attack with Wrecking Ball, draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, intimidate.

writhing_beast_hulk.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
writhing_beast_hulk.text_zh:
作为使用扭动的野兽巨躯的额外费用，随机放逐你坟场中的3张牌。
若以此方式放逐的是一张力量为6或更高的牌，扭动的野兽巨躯获得支配。
血债
writhing_beast_hulk.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Writhing Beast Hulk, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard.
If a card with 6 or more {p} is banished this way, Writhing Beast Hulk gains dominate.
Blood Debt

written_in_the_stars.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动
written_in_the_stars.text_zh:
创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
若本回合你造成过秘法伤害，抽一张牌。
written_in_the_stars.text_en:
Create an Embodiment of Lightning token.
If you've dealt arcane damage this turn, draw a card.
